summary_1line: Sanjaya warns Dhritarashtra of the Pandavas’ unstoppable wrath after Draupadi’s humiliation; the narrative shifts to their disciplined forest life during exile.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima, lips trembling with fury in the royal assembly, vows to smash Duryodhana’s exposed thighs with his descending mace.
Arjuna battles the god Shiva disguised as a wild Kirata hunter in a rugged forest, both warriors locked in fierce combat.
In the forest camp, Draupadi serves food to the Pandavas and gathered Brahmanas, eating last after caring for all.
